It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The GST of 18% shall be added separately to the estimate as per Govt Order No. PWD 51 RDF 2019, Bengaluru Dated : 18-03-2022.
All Terms and Conditions as per bid documents

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: P-6Providing Cover Slab Above RCC Drain in Ward No. 01 in Bhagyanagar TP Limit.

itemList.description: Providing and laying 100mm thick pre-cast cover slabs over drains & Rain pit of width not exceeding 800 mm using M20 concrete reinforced with Micro Alloyed High carbon steel with 3mm - 3ply wired steel @ 2.00 kg/m2, slabs jointed in CM 1:3 proportion and nicely finished Including providing holes in the Cover slabs wherever necessary for easy drainage of surface water including of labour, materials, scaffolding, usage of machinery, curing, lead and lift charges etc, Complete.
